entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria where the Odyssey storyline takes place, about a century after the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The devastated plane on which Otaria lies.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A young Pardic barbarian and warrior proficient with weapons and fire magic who seeks glory in the Cabal's pits; protagonist of the storyline.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Kamahl's sister, whom he leaves behind in the Pardic Mountains.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A magical orb that calls out to all who gaze upon it, filling their heads with delusions of grandeur and dreams of conquest.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: An occult and sinister organization that controls most of the land and its wealth and runs pit fights.

entities.name: Cabal Patriarch
entities.description: The leader of the Cabal.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A member of the Cabal.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A member of the Cabal.

entities.name: The Order
entities.description: An army-structured faction of desert nomads and aven warriors striving to break the Cabal's iron fist.

entities.name: Kirtar
entities.description: A militaristic leader of the Order.

entities.name: Pianna
entities.description: A leader of the Order.

entities.name: Teroh
entities.description: A leader of the Order.

entities.name: Eesha
entities.description: A leader of the Order.

entities.name: Mer Empire
entities.description: The highly advanced underwater empire of the cephalids that schemes for absolute control of the continent.

entities.name: Aboshan
entities.description: The leader of the Mer Empire.

entities.name: Llawan
entities.description: Aboshan's wife, a leader of the Mer Empire.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: The ambassador to the Cabal who advises the Mer Empire.

entities.name: Krosan Forest
entities.description: A forest that survived the Phyrexian plague, now self-sufficient and hostile to outsiders.

entities.name: Thriss
entities.description: A figure of the Krosan Forest more receptive to outsiders.

entities.name: Seton
entities.description: A figure of the Krosan Forest more receptive to outsiders.

entities.name: Pardic Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where barbarians and dwarves continue age-old territorial skirmishes.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The earlier war whose end occurred a century before Odyssey.

events.summary: The Odyssey storyline begins on Otaria a century after the Phyrexian Invasion, introducing Kamahl as protagonist.
events.quote: it introduces Kamahl as a protagonist

events.summary: The Cabal controls most of the land and wealth, running pit fights for the masses.
events.quote: it operates pit fights for entertainment of the masses and, for the one lucky pit warrior who survives, fame and fortune

events.summary: The Order strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace.
events.quote: strives to break the Cabal's iron fist over the populace

events.summary: The Mer Empire schemes for absolute control by flooding the continent and killing the "inferior air-breathers".
events.quote: scheme for absolute control of the continent by flooding the continent and killing the "inferior air-breathers"

events.summary: Kamahl leaves the Pardic Mountains and his sister Jeska to make a name for himself, drawn by the Mirari.
events.quote: In leaving behind the Pardic Mountains, where age-old territorial skirmishes between the barbarians and dwarves continue to rage on, Kamahl leaves his sister Jeska
